This appeal is filed by the claimants challenging the judgment and award dated 01.04.2021, in MVC No.116/2010, by the Court of Addl. Senior Civil Judge and VI MACT, Jamakhandi, seeking enhancement of compensation.

sentences.text: 2. The factum of accident, death of the deceased in the accident, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.

3. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.
4.
In the present case the tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.11,83,984/-.
Among them, a sum of Rs.40,000/- only is awarded towards loss of consortium.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13460 On all other heads i.e., towards loss of dependency, towards loss of estate and towards funeral expenses the compensation awarded are found to be just and proper and correct.
The claimants are wife and two children.
Therefore, each of the claimants are entitled for compensation of Rs.40,000/- towards loss of consortium including loss of love and affection with escalation of 10%.

Therefore, the tribunal ought to have awarded compensation of Rs.1,32,000/-
(Rs.40,000 x 3 + 10%) towards loss of consortium, but awarded only Rs.40,000/-.
Therefore, the claimants are entitled for remaining Rs.92,000/- under this head.

5. Therefore, the claimants are entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.92,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the tribunal.
The insurance company shall deposit the NC: 2023:KHC-D:13460 compensation amount within eight weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.

6. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The judgment and award dated 01.04.2021, in MVC No.116/2010, passed by the Court of Addl.
Senior Civil Judge and VI MACT, Jamakhandi, stands modified.
